title: Order an eMU Casual Pass
summary: Order an eMU Casual Pass online to use Sydney toll roads for up to 30 days.
intro:
If you'd like to use Sydney toll roads for up to 30 days, you can order an eMU Casual Pass online. This pass isn't physically attached to the vehicle. It's linked to the licence plate number, so you can use it for your own car/motorbike or a rental vehicle.

When passing through a toll, your number plate is photographed and your account charged.
who_can_apply: The eMU Casual Pass allows travel on Sydney toll roads for up to 30 days.
what_you_need: A current credit card or Visa/Mastercard debit card that is valid for a minimum of 3 months.
Your travel start and end dates.

how_to_steps.text: Read and accept the Terms and Conditions.
Choose how you'd like the receipt delivered.

more_info.text: Payments for tolls may not be charged to the credit card the same day as travel.
Your credit card or Visa/Mastercard debit card must be valid for a minimum of 3 months.

external_links.text: Proving your identity – Transport for NSW

faqs.q: How long is the eMU Casual Pass valid for?
faqs.a: The eMU Casual Pass allows you to travel on Sydney toll roads for up to 30 days.

faqs.q: Does the pass need to be physically attached to the vehicle?
faqs.a: No, the pass is not physically attached to the vehicle; it is linked to the licence plate number.

faqs.q: Can I cover past travel dates?
faqs.a: Yes, you can backdate your travel start date to cover your previous 3 days of travel on toll roads.
